name: More school
about: The next 114 Dutch words for school and studying, by how much they're used, each in an everyday sentence written for it. They're the same sentences as in the Dutch word packs (words 1–20,000), so what you learn here counts there too, and the other way round. Word list: FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave, from OpenSubtitles (opensubtitles.org), CC BY-SA 4.0.

words.zoeken: to look for, to search for
words.staan: to stand; to be (located, in a state); to say (of text); to be depicted; to suit
words.hij: he; him; it (referring to a de-word)
words.gaan: to go; to be going to; to be about (with over); to start
words.vast: fixed, firm; steady, permanent; regular, usual; solid; stuck; surely, probably
words.afkijken: to copy, to cheat; to learn by watching; to finish watching
words.er: there; it, them (with a preposition); of it, of them (with a quantity)
words.liggen: to lie (be horizontal); to be located
words.op: on; at; up; used up, finished, gone; for; to; with; of; after (with passen)
words.mijn: my, mine; mine (excavation or explosive device)
words.vak: subject (at school); trade, profession; compartment, section
words.vinden: to find; to think (have an opinion)
words.horen: to hear; to belong; to be supposed to
words.die: that, those; who, that (introducing a relative clause)
words.kunnen: to be able to, can; may, might
words.overhoren: to quiz, to test (someone on learned material)
words.zwaar: heavy; difficult, tough; severe, harsh; powerful
words.om: around; at (a time); for; about, over; to (with te)
words.bespreken: to discuss; to reserve, to book
words.bijleren: to learn more, learn something new
words.zij: she; her; they; them; it (referring to a feminine noun); side
words.doen: to do, to make; to put; to act, to behave; to hurt (pijn); to give (regards)
words.over: about; over, across; in (time); on (tax, interest); left, remaining; finished
words.naast: next to, beside; besides, in addition to
words.al: already, yet; all, every; even; although, even if
words.te: to (before an infinitive); too; at, for (in fixed expressions)
words.voor: for; before; in front of, ahead of; of (fear); from (danger); to
words.jullie: you (more than one person, informal); your (plural, informal)
words.langskomen: to come by, drop by; to pass by
words.maken: to make; to do; to fix; to take (a photo, test); to worry (zich zorgen maken)
words.schrift: notebook, exercise book; writing, script; scripture
words.kiezen: to choose, to pick; to elect
words.nog: still; yet; more, another; even (comparatives); as recently as
words.zitten: to sit; to be (in a place or situation); to fit (clothing)
words.zetten: to put, to place; to set, to adjust; to make (coffee, tea); to brace oneself
words.blokken: to cram, study hard; to block
words.dragen: to carry; to wear; to bear, to support
words.extra: extra, additional; extra (to a greater degree)
words.liniaal: ruler (for measuring or drawing straight lines)
words.bijzitten: to sit in (at a meeting or exam); to sit with
words.gymnasium: academic high school (with Latin and Greek)
words.graag: gladly, with pleasure; like to (with a verb)
words.brossen: to skip school, to cut class (in Belgium)
words.lyceum: secondary school offering both atheneum and gymnasium programs
words.zo: so; like this, like that; easily; in a moment
words.voorlezen: to read aloud, to read to someone

items.means: The marker is on the table.
wrong: Het viltstift ligt op tafel.
De viltstift ligt op het tafel.

items.text: Dit enkelvoud staat in het boek.
items.means: This singular form is in the book.
wrong: Deze enkelvoud staat in het boek.
Die enkelvoud staat in het boek.

items.text: Is iedereen in jouw familie geletterd?
items.means: Is everyone in your family literate?
wrong: Iedereen in jouw familie geletterd is?
Zijn iedereen in jouw familie geletterd?

items.text: Morgen hebben we weer maatschappijleer.
items.means: We have civics again tomorrow.
wrong: Morgen we hebben weer maatschappijleer.
Morgen we weer hebben maatschappijleer.

items.text: Ik koop dit studieboek, want ik heb het nodig.
items.means: I'm buying this textbook because I need it.
wrong: Ik koop dit studieboek, want ik het nodig heb.
Ik koop dit studieboek, want ik het heb nodig.

items.text: Ons studentje komt dit weekend thuis.
items.means: Our college kid is coming home this weekend.
wrong: Onze studentje komt dit weekend thuis.
Onzen studentje komt dit weekend thuis.

items.text: Volgend jaar kies ik een ander bijvak.
items.means: Next year I'll choose a different minor subject.
wrong: Volgend jaar ik kies een ander bijvak.
Volgend jaar een ander bijvak ik kies.

items.text: Hij is geen schooldirecteur, maar leraar.
items.means: He's a teacher, not a school principal.
wrong: Hij is geen de schooldirecteur, maar leraar.
Hij is een geen schooldirecteur, maar leraar.

items.text: Deze schooljuf leest elke dag voor.
items.means: This schoolteacher reads aloud every day.
wrong: Dit schooljuf leest elke dag voor.
Dat schooljuf leest elke dag voor.

items.text: Een nieuw studiejaar begint in september.
items.means: A new academic year begins in September.
wrong: Een nieuwe studiejaar begint in september.
Een nieuwen studiejaar begint in september.
